title: Pbc scalar square on ordinary complexes
statement: For any f:X→Y, n≥0 and arbitrary cochain complex P of completed integral modules on Y, the pbc scalar-pull comparison followed by geometric pullback of the pbc scalar counit at Y, its geometric computation factor, Q of pullback of the ordinary scalar presentation at Y, and Q of the ordinary finite geometric presentation, equals pbc scalar extension of the completed geometric computation factor, followed by the pbc scalar counit at X, Q of the ordinary scalar presentation at X, Q of ordinaryFiniteScalarPullComplex and Q of the level-to-intrinsic presentation. This is an ordinary-complex statement and needs no good-complex, K-flatness or realization-model hypothesis.

source.place: Pbc scalar square on ordinary complexes in the finite scalar cochain calculation; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Reverse scalarPull_complex_normalization by cancellation of its scalar-pull and ordinary complex isomorphisms. This gives q.hom composed with the Y counit and geometric computation factor as the X geometric computation factor, X counit and Q of the inverse ordinary scalar square.
Apply Q to finiteScalarPullComplexPresentation, expand Q on the threefold composites, and compose the resulting equality with the preceding geometric factor and X pbc counit.

theorem finiteScalarPullPbcNormalization {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) :
    let := sfIntrinsicPullback_additive (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let := scalarReductionExtensionAdditive.{u, u} l E X n
    let := scalarReductionExtensionAdditive.{u, u} l E Y n
    let a := PurCompactSupport.reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)
    let S := PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)
    let F := integralOrdinaryPull l E f
    let T := proEtaleRingModulePullback f (S.ring Y) (S.ring X) (S.pull f)
    let TD := PurCompactSupport.pull S f
    let CY := ((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let BY := ((pbcExtend (a.map Y)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let αYc := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      (finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso l E Y n).hom (.up ℤ)).app P
    let αXc := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      (finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso l E X n).hom (.up ℤ)).app
        ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    (PurCompactSupport.scalarPull a f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
      TD.map (pbcComplexCounit (a.map Y) P) ≫ T.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app BY ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map αYc) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (PurCompactSupport.finitePullbackIso l E n f)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app CY) =
    (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map X)).map (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
      pbcComplexCounit (a.map X) ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map αXc ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (ordinaryFiniteScalarPullComplex l E f n P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E f n)
          (.up ℤ)).hom.app CY)
